hints.title: Palindrome Parity Condition
hints.text: A path can form a palindrome if and only if at most one digit has an odd frequency along the path.

hints.title: Bitmask for Parities
hints.text: Represent digit frequencies using a bitmask of 10 bits where bit d is flipped when visiting value d.

hints.title: Power of Two Check
hints.text: At a leaf node, check if mask & (mask - 1) == 0. If true, at most one bit is set, so the path is pseudo-palindromic.

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Maintaining full frequency arrays and copying them down branches uses extra memory.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: An integer bitmask tracks parities with O(1) bitwise XOR operations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate utilizes bitmask XOR and mask & (mask - 1) power-of-two trick at leaves.
